method: Independent binary glTF accessor inspection per mesh node. Degenerate threshold triangle area < 1e-12 m²; tiny nonzero < 1e-8 m². Normals invalid if nonfinite or length differs from 1 by >0.01. Texture GPU estimate assumes uncompressed RGBA8 plus complete mip chain; actual driver allocation may differ. Geometry quantities in node-local metric coordinates, exported node transforms are near unit.
